title: Would you answer the voice in the wall? 👻 #shorts
description: Tennessee, 1817: the Bell family heard knocking in the walls, then a voice that called every one of them by name. A real American legend, first written in full in 1894. Full story on the channel. #shorts #bellwitch #truestory #legend #hollowmere

beats.en: Tennessee, 1817. The Bell family heard knocking inside their walls.
beats.es: Tennessee, 1817. Los Bell oían golpes dentro de sus paredes.
beats.de: Tennessee, 1817. Familie Bell hörte Klopfen in ihren Wänden.
beats.fr: Tennessee, 1817. Les Bell entendaient frapper dans leurs murs.
beats.it: Tennessee, 1817. I Bell sentivano bussare dentro i muri.
beats.pt: Tennessee, 1817. Os Bell ouviam batidas dentro das paredes.

beats.en: Then a voice began to talk. It knew every name in the house.
beats.es: Luego una voz empezó a hablar. Sabía todos los nombres de la casa.
beats.de: Dann sprach eine Stimme. Sie kannte jeden Namen im Haus.
beats.fr: Puis une voix se mit à parler. Elle connaissait chaque nom de la maison.
beats.it: Poi una voce iniziò a parlare. Conosceva ogni nome della casa.
beats.pt: Então uma voz começou a falar. Sabia todos os nomes da casa.

beats.en: Something was knocking inside the walls...
beats.es: Algo golpeaba dentro de las paredes...
beats.fr: Quelque chose frappait dans les murs...
